description: One-time worker sign-in so Prism can run local job teammates. The worker matches the host (ADR-0044): in Cursor a Cursor login page opens in the browser; in Claude Code this checks the claude CLI is installed and signed in, and the message says what to run when it is not. Speak only the tool message to the user — never mention API keys, mcp.json, host role, or connector counts. If Cursor shows “Authenticating prism…” with Skip, that is host tool-approval: tell the user to click Skip, then retry init.
name: init
title: Set up Dispatch workers
